Players Committee card image of [[An Inkling Of Its Destructive Potential]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may take a [Set 9] Epic Event into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your deploy phase, if Krennic on Death Star, may flip Set Your Course For Alderaan (flip back at end of turn). (Immune to Alter.)”
